title: ReDence: A Hybrid Agentic and Decision-Model Framework for Rapid, Evidence-Grounded Detection of Modern Social Engineering Scams
abstract: arXiv:2610.30963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detecting online social engineering (SE) scams often requires examining website workflows, verifying claims against external sources, and connecting evidence across multiple pages. Existing detectors provide limited support for these investigations, leaving analysts to manually gather and validate evidence, which inevitably delays detection and subsequent takedown of these attacks. To address this gap, we present ReDence, an open-source hybrid framework for adaptive, evidence-grounded detection across diverse SE scam categories. ReDence combines two locally hosted models with complementary responsibilities: a fine-tuned multimodal agentic Investigator (Qwen3.5-4B) that performs investigative planning, evidence interpretation, and reporting, and a specialized Decider (Tev1) that handles binary and multiple-choice tasks, including browser-action selection, evidence assessment, and decisions about whether to continue an investigation. By

translated_title: ReDence：用于快速、基于证据检测现代社会工程学诈骗的混合智能体与决策模型框架
translated_abstract: 检测在线社会工程学（SE）诈骗通常需要检查网站工作流程、对照外部来源核实相关声明，并跨多个页面关联证据。现有检测器对此类调查提供的支持有限，导致分析人员不得不手动收集和验证证据，这不可避免地延迟了此类攻击的检测与后续下架。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了ReDence，一个开源的混合框架，可跨多种SE诈骗类别实现自适应、基于证据的检测。ReDence结合了两个本地部署、职责互补的模型：一个是经过微调的多模态智能体“调查员”（Investigator，Qwen3.5-4B），负责调查规划、证据解读与报告生成；另一个是专门的“决策器”（Decider，Tev1），负责处理二选一与多选任务，包括浏览器操作选择、证据评估，以及是否继续调查的决策。
tldr: 该论文提出开源混合框架ReDence，通过微调多模态智能体“调查员”与专用“决策器”模型协同工作，实现对社会工程学诈骗的快速、自适应、基于证据的自动化检测。
en_tdlr: ReDence is an open-source hybrid framework that pairs a fine-tuned multimodal agentic Investigator with a specialized Decider model to enable rapid, adaptive, evidence-grounded detection of modern social engineering scams.
